description: Every series the stock passport keeps for one share: the daily supply waterfall per token (from the first daily snapshot), units outside the issuer rebuilt from transfers, the daily widest gap to the share, tracking against the reference, and every corporate action read with whether the issuer’s multiplier confirms it. Each series says read or not_read with its reason; early on the snapshots say "not yet read", never zero. PAID, five cents a call over x402 (or a plan); a share that matches nothing is refused before any payment. WHY readOnlyHint IS false: calling it WITH an x402 payment authorisation transfers USDC from the caller to us and records a receipt; called without one it changes nothing and answers with the price.

isin.description: An ISIN (US88160R1014); a token symbol (TSLAx) or a share ticker (TSLA) is also accepted.

name: stock_passport_history

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

corporateActions.description: state and items: every action read.

gaps.description: state and days: the widest gap to the share per token and day.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

payment.description: What was paid and how it settled.

supply.description: state, reason and days: the daily waterfall per token.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
